title: English Practice Quiz 0134
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.
